x: He was interested in Tom Jones' contribution to our last issue, but Mr. Murphy can go back only twenty years when, he claims, he was the slowest walker the Club has had and he boasts that on one occasion he was cautioned! and he a London-Brighton man too!
The 880 yards handicap saw two new members out in front and both Murphy and Coxon are very useful additions to our ranks. Doug Briggs managed to gain third place in a fast-run race.
"C"—112, Godfrey, J.; 125, Murphy; 142, Brooks; 161, Mitchell, R.; 182, Lacey, J.; 231, Coxon. "D"—166, Whitehead; 168, Tween; 205, Saville; 206, Housego, A.; 264, Lacey, E.
